_about: 1-Propanol (1) + Isoamyl alcohol (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 101.3 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-propanol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: J. M. Resa, C. Gonzalez, J. M. Goenaga, Density, Refractive Index, Speed of Sound at 298.15 K, and Vapor-Liquid Equilibria at 101.3 kPa for Binary Mixtures of Propanol + 2-Methyl-1-butanol and Propanol + 3-Methyl-1-butanol, J. Chem. Eng. Data 51 (2006) 73-78
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 20, 22. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.21 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
